title: DistributionDetails
description: Lazy-fetched per-CID developer-grade distribution view. Strict superset of DistributionSummary: includes per-replica peer rows, projector identities, placement gaps, and recent projection events. Source of truth: composed from rea_commitments + economic_events + peer_identity_bindings + libp2p swarm state (Operational, Category C). Reconstructed per request; not persisted.

summary.description: Inline summary — same shape returned on every CID-bearing response.

replicaPeers.description: Per-replica detail (peer id, archetype, freshness, hop hint, etc).

placementGaps.description: Concrete placement gaps for this content; empty if fully placed.

recentProjectionEvents.description: Recent rea projection-event records relevant to this CID. Open-shape during bring-up.

commitmentReferences.description: CustodianCommitment CID references (rea_commitments rows) backing this distribution snapshot.

replicationCommitments.description: Active replicates-* commitments whose recipient + scope_filter cover this content.
